notes.content: You know that feeling when you put in your headphones because you just don't want to deal — right? You're comfortable. The noise is gone. That's the weight you walked in here carrying today, and Jehovah is naming it. Because Jeremiah 5:31 doesn't just describe corrupt leaders. It says 'my own people love it that way.' Not tolerate it. Love it. They curated their own comfort. And that's the part that should stop us cold — because Amos 8:11 talks about a famine 'not of bread' but of 'hearing the words of Jehovah.' When you love the smooth message long enough, you lose the ability to even hear the real one. So when Jehovah asks, 'what will you do when the end comes?' — that's not ancient history. That question is live. Right now. You walk out of here not asking what they will do. You walk out asking what you will do — and that's different.
